message.content:
사전(Dictionary) 조회 API의 정렬 로직을 탐색해주세요.

찾아야 할 것:
1. DictionaryController에서 목록 조회 엔드포인트 (GET /{type})
2. DictionaryService에서 조회 메서드
3. DictionaryRepository 인터페이스와 구현체(DictionaryRepositoryImpl)의 조회 메서드
4. 현재 정렬 방식 (updatedTime, createdTime 순으로 되어 있다고 함)
5. 페이지네이션 방식 (Search After 사용 여부)

각 파일의 경로와 관련 메서드, 현재 정렬 로직을 상세히 알려주세요.

content.text: 사전 조회 API의 정렬 로직을 탐색하겠습니다. 먼저 프로젝트 구조를 파악하고 관련 파일들을 찾겠습니다.
좋습니다. 이제 각 파일을 읽어서 정렬 로직을 상세히 분석하겠습니다.

1→package com.cowave.search.service
     2→
     3→import co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.low_level.Request
     4→import co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.low_level.Rest5Client
     5→import com.cowave.search.controller.dto.AllTypesCountResponse
     6→import com.cowave.search.controller.dto.AllTypesLastModifiedResponse
     7→import com.cowave.search.controller.dto.CompileResult

     9→import com.cowave.search.controller.dto.PagedResponse
    10→import com.cowave.search.controller.dto.TypeCountResponse
    11→import com.cowave.search.controller.dto.TypeLastModifiedResponse
    12→import com.cowave.search.domain.dictionary.DictionaryWithId
    13→import com.cowave.search.domain.dictionary.Type
    14→import com.cowave.search.utils.DictionaryBinaryCompile
    15→import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
    16→import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
    17→import java.util.Base64
    18→
    19→@Service
    20→class DictionaryService(
    21→    val dictionaryRepository: DictionaryRepository,
    22→    val dictionaryBinaryCompile: DictionaryBinaryCompile,
    23→    val restClient: Rest5Client,
    24→) {
    25→    private val logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DictionaryService::class.java)
    26→
    27→    fun getByType(
    28→        type: Type,
    29→        page: Int,
    30→        size: Int,
    31→    ): PagedResponse<DictionaryWithId> {
    32→        val result = dictionaryRepository.findAllWithPageByType(type, page, size)
    33→        return PagedResponse.of(result.items, result.total, page, size)
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    fun getByTypeWithCursor(
    37→        type: Type,
    38→        size: Int,
    39→        cursor: String?,
    40→    ): CursorPagedResponse<DictionaryWithId> {
    41→        val searchAfterList = cursor?.let { decodeCursor(it) }
    42→        val result = dictionaryRepository.findAllWithSearchAfterByType(type, size, searchAfterList)
    43→
    44→        return CursorPagedResponse(
    45→            items = result.items,
    46→            total = result.total,
    47→            nextCursor = result.nextSearchAfter?.let { encodeCursor(it) },
    48→            hasNext = result.hasNext,
    49→        )
    50→    }
    51→
    52→    private fun encodeCursor(values: List<String>): String =
    53→        Base64.getUrlEncoder().encodeToString(values.joinToString(CURSOR_DELIMITER).toByteArray())
    54→
    55→    private fun decodeCursor(cursor: String): List<String> = String(Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(cursor)).split(CURSOR_DELIMITER)
    56→
    57→    fun searchByWord(
    58→        word: String,
    59→        type: Type,
    60→        isMatch: Boolean,
    61→    ): List<DictionaryWithId> = dictionaryRepository.findByWordAndType(word, type, isMatch)
    62→
    63→    fun create(
    64→        keyword: String?,
    65→        type: Type,
    66→        value: String?,
    67→    ) {
    68→        dictionaryRepository.insert(keyword, type, value)
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    fun update(
    72→        id: String,
    73→        keyword: String,
    74→        type: Type,
    75→        value: String?,
    76→    ) {
    77→        dictionaryRepository.update(id, keyword, type, value)
    78→    }
    79→
    80→    fun delete(id: String) {
    81→        dictionaryRepository.delete(id)
    82→    }
    83→
    84→    fun countByType(type: Type): Long = dictionaryRepository.countByType(type)
    85→
    86→    fun compile(type: Type): CompileResult {
    87→        val result = compileWithoutReload(type)
    88→        reloadDictionary()
    89→        return result
    90→    }
    91→
    92→    fun compileAll(): List<CompileResult> {
    93→        val results = Type.compilableTypes.map { compileWithoutReload(it) }
    94→        reloadDictionary()
    95→        return results
    96→    }
    97→
    98→    private fun compileWithoutReload(type: Type): CompileResult {
    99→        require(type.isCompilable) {
   100→            "Type $type is not compilable"
   101→        }
   102→
   103→        val dictionaries = dictionaryRepository.findAllByType(type)
   104→        val pairs = dictionaries.map { it.keyword to it.value }
   105→        val outputFile = dictionaryBinaryCompile.compileToConfiguredPath(pairs, type)
   106→
   107→        return CompileResult(
   108→            type = type,
   109→            count = dictionaries.size,
   110→            filePath = outputFile.absolutePath,
   111→            fileSize = outputFile.length(),
   112→        )
   113→    }
   114→
   115→    private fun reloadDictionary() {
   116→        logger.info("Reloading dictionary in Elasticsearch...")
   117→        val request = Request("POST", "/_analysis-product-name/reload-dict")
   118→        val response = restClient.performRequest(request)
   119→        val statusCode = response.statusCode
   120→        if (statusCode !in 200..299) {
   121→            throw RuntimeException("Failed to reload dictionary: HTTP $statusCode")
   122→        }
   123→        logger.info("Dictionary reload completed successfully")
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    fun getLastModifiedByType(type: Type): TypeLastModifiedResponse {
   127→        val (lastModified, count) = dictionaryRepository.findLastModifiedByType(type)
   128→        return TypeLastModifiedResponse(
   129→            type = type,
   130→            lastModified = lastModified,
   131→            count = count,
   132→        )
   133→    }
   134→
   135→    fun getAllTypesLastModified(): AllTypesLastModifiedResponse {
   136→        val allTypesData = dictionaryRepository.findLastModifiedForAllTypes()
   137→        val items =
   138→            Type.entries.map { type ->
   139→                val (lastModified, count) = allTypesData[type] ?: Pair(null, 0L)
   140→                TypeLastModifiedResponse(
   141→                    type = type,
   142→                    lastModified = lastModified,
   143→                    count = count,
   144→                )
   145→            }
   146→        return AllTypesLastModifiedResponse(items)
   147→    }
   148→
   149→    fun getAllTypesCounts(): AllTypesCountResponse {
   150→        val allTypesCounts = dictionaryRepository.countAllTypes()
   151→        val items =
   152→            Type.entries.map { type ->
   153→                TypeCountResponse(
   154→                    type = type,
   155→                    count = allTypesCounts[type] ?: 0L,
   156→                )
   157→            }
   158→        val totalCount = items.sumOf { it.count }
   159→        return AllTypesCountResponse(items, totalCount)
   160→    }
   161→
   162→    companion object {
   163→        private const val CURSOR_DELIMITER = "|"
   164→    }
   165→}
   166→

1→package com.cowave.search.infrastructure
     2→
     3→import co.elastic.clients.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchClient
     4→import co.elastic.clients.elasticsearch._types.FieldValue
     5→import co.elastic.clients.elasticsearch._types.SortOptions
     6→import co.elastic.clients.elasticsearch._types.SortOrder
     7→import co.elastic.clients.elasticsearch._types.query_dsl.Query
     8→import com.cowave.search.domain.dictionary.Dictionary
     9→import com.cowave.search.domain.dictionary.DictionaryWithId
    10→import com.cowave.search.domain.dictionary.Type
    11→import com.cowave.search.domain.document.PagedResult
    12→import com.cowave.search.domain.document.SearchAfterResult
    13→import com.cowave.search.service.DictionaryRepository
    14→import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository
    15→import java.time.Instant
    16→
    17→@Repository
    18→class DictionaryRepositoryImpl(
    19→    val esClient: ElasticsearchClient,
    20→) : DictionaryRepository {
    21→    override fun findAllWithPageByType(
    22→        type: Type,
    23→        page: Int,
    24→        size: Int,
    25→    ): PagedResult<DictionaryWithId> {
    26→        val response =
    27→            esClient.search(
    28→                { s ->
    29→                    s
    30→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
    31→                        .trackTotalHits { it.enabled(true) }
    32→                        .query { q ->
    33→                            q.bool { b ->
    34→                                b.filter { f ->
    35→                                    f.term { t ->
    36→                                        t
    37→                                            .field("type")
    38→                                            .value { v -> v.stringValue(type.toString()) }
    39→                                    }
    40→                                }
    41→                            }
    42→                        }.from(page * size)
    43→                        .size(size)
    44→                        .sort(baseSortQuery())
    45→                },
    46→                Dictionary::class.java,
    47→            )
    48→
    49→        val items =
    50→            response.hits().hits().mapNotNull { hit ->
    51→                hit.id()?.let { id -> hit.source()?.let { DictionaryWithId(id, it) } }
    52→            }
    53→        val total = response.hits().total()?.value() ?: 0L
    54→
    55→        return PagedResult(items, total)
    56→    }
    57→
    58→    override fun findAllWithSearchAfterByType(
    59→        type: Type,
    60→        size: Int,
    61→        searchAfter: List<String>?,
    62→    ): SearchAfterResult<DictionaryWithId> {
    63→        val response =
    64→            esClient.search(
    65→                { s ->
    66→                    s
    67→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
    68→                        .trackTotalHits { it.enabled(true) }
    69→                        .query { q ->
    70→                            q.bool { b ->
    71→                                b.filter { f ->
    72→                                    f.term { t ->
    73→                                        t
    74→                                            .field("type")
    75→                                            .value { v -> v.stringValue(type.toString()) }
    76→                                    }
    77→                                }
    78→                            }
    79→                        }.size(size)
    80→                        .sort(searchAfterSortQuery())
    81→                        .apply {
    82→                            searchAfter?.let { sa ->
    83→                                searchAfter(sa.map { FieldValue.of(it) })
    84→                            }
    85→                        }
    86→                },
    87→                Dictionary::class.java,
    88→            )
    89→
    90→        val hits = response.hits().hits()
    91→        val items =
    92→            hits.mapNotNull { hit ->
    93→                hit.id()?.let { id -> hit.source()?.let { DictionaryWithId(id, it) } }
    94→            }
    95→        val total = response.hits().total()?.value() ?: 0L
    96→        // Extract actual values from FieldValue (sort fields are all long values: dates as epoch millis, _shard_doc)
    97→        val nextSearchAfter =
    98→            hits.lastOrNull()?.sort()?.map { fieldValue ->
    99→                fieldValue._get().toString()
   100→            }
   101→        val hasNext = hits.size == size && nextSearchAfter != null
   102→
   103→        return SearchAfterResult(items, total, nextSearchAfter, hasNext)
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    override fun findByWordAndType(
   107→        word: String,
   108→        type: Type,
   109→        isMatch: Boolean,
   110→    ): List<DictionaryWithId> {
   111→        val shouldQuery =
   112→            if (isMatch) {
   113→                Query.of {
   114→                    it.match { m ->
   115→                        m.field("keyword")
   116→                        m.query { q ->
   117→                            q.stringValue(word)
   118→                        }
   119→                    }
   120→                    it.match { m2 ->
   121→                        m2.field("value")
   122→                        m2.query { q2 ->
   123→                            q2.stringValue(word)
   124→                        }
   125→                    }
   126→                }
   127→            } else {
   128→                Query.of {
   129→                    it.wildcard { w ->
   130→                        w.field("keyword")
   131→                        w.value("*$word*")
   132→                    }
   133→                    it.wildcard { w2 ->
   134→                        w2.field("value")
   135→                        w2.value("*$word*")
   136→                    }
   137→                }
   138→            }
   139→
   140→        val response =
   141→            esClient.search(
   142→                { s ->
   143→                    s
   144→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   145→                        .query { q ->
   146→                            q.bool { b ->
   147→                                b.filter { f ->
   148→                                    f.term { t ->
   149→                                        t
   150→                                            .field("type")
   151→                                            .value { v -> v.stringValue(type.toString()) }
   152→                                    }
   153→                                }
   154→                                b.should(shouldQuery)
   155→                            }
   156→                        }.sort(baseSortQuery())
   157→                },
   158→                Dictionary::class.java,
   159→            )
   160→
   161→        return response.hits().hits().mapNotNull { hit ->
   162→            hit.id()?.let { id -> hit.source()?.let { DictionaryWithId(id, it) } }
   163→        }
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    override fun findAllByType(type: Type): List<Dictionary> {
   167→        val allResults = mutableListOf<Dictionary>()
   168→        var searchAfter: List<FieldValue>? = null
   169→        val batchSize = 10000
   170→
   171→        do {
   172→            val response =
   173→                esClient.search(
   174→                    { s ->
   175→                        s
   176→                            .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   177→                            .query { q ->
   178→                                q.term { t ->
   179→                                    t
   180→                                        .field("type")
   181→                                        .value { v -> v.stringValue(type.toString()) }
   182→                                }
   183→                            }.size(batchSize)
   184→                            .sort { so ->
   185→                                so.field { f ->
   186→                                    f.field("createdTime").order(SortOrder.Asc)
   187→                                }
   188→                            }.apply {
   189→                                searchAfter?.let { sa -> searchAfter(sa) }
   190→                            }
   191→                    },
   192→                    Dictionary::class.java,
   193→                )
   194→
   195→            val hits = response.hits().hits()
   196→            hits.mapNotNull { it.source() }.let { allResults.addAll(it) }
   197→
   198→            searchAfter = hits.lastOrNull()?.sort()
   199→        } while (searchAfter != null && response.hits().hits().size == batchSize)
   200→
   201→        return allResults
   202→    }
   203→
   204→    override fun insert(
   205→        keyword: String?,
   206→        type: Type,
   207→        value: String?,
   208→    ) {
   209→        esClient.index {
   210→            it.index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   211→            it.document(
   212→                Dictionary.of(
   213→                    keyword = keyword,
   214→                    type = type,
   215→                    value = value,
   216→                    createdTime = Instant.now(),
   217→                    updatedTime = Instant.now(),
   218→                ),
   219→            )
   220→        }
   221→    }
   222→
   223→    override fun update(
   224→        id: String,
   225→        keyword: String,
   226→        type: Type,
   227→        value: String?,
   228→    ) {
   229→        esClient.update(
   230→            {
   231→                it
   232→                    .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   233→                    .id(id)
   234→                    .doc(
   235→                        mapOf(
   236→                            "keyword" to keyword,
   237→                            "value" to value,
   238→                            "updatedTime" to Instant.now(),
   239→                        ),
   240→                    )
   241→            },
   242→            Dictionary::class.java,
   243→        )
   244→    }
   245→
   246→    override fun delete(id: String) {
   247→        esClient.delete {
   248→            it.index(DICTIONARY_INDEX).id(id)
   249→        }
   250→    }
   251→
   252→    override fun countByType(type: Type): Long =
   253→        esClient
   254→            .count {
   255→                it
   256→                    .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   257→                    .query { q ->
   258→                        q.term { t ->
   259→                            t.field("type").value(type.name)
   260→                        }
   261→                    }
   262→            }.count()
   263→
   264→    override fun findLastModifiedByType(type: Type): Pair<Instant?, Long> {
   265→        val response =
   266→            esClient.search(
   267→                { s ->
   268→                    s
   269→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   270→                        .size(0) // We only need aggregation results, not documents
   271→                        .query { q ->
   272→                            q.term { t ->
   273→                                t.field("type").value(type.name)
   274→                            }
   275→                        }.aggregations("max_updated_time") { agg ->
   276→                            agg.max { m -> m.field("updatedTime") }
   277→                        }
   278→                },
   279→                Dictionary::class.java,
   280→            )
   281→
   282→        val total = response.hits().total()?.value() ?: 0L
   283→        val maxAgg = response.aggregations()["max_updated_time"]?.max()
   284→        // ES returns NaN for empty aggregation results
   285→        val lastModified =
   286→            maxAgg?.value()?.takeIf { !it.isNaN() }?.let {
   287→                Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.toLong())
   288→            }
   289→
   290→        return Pair(lastModified, total)
   291→    }
   292→
   293→    override fun findLastModifiedForAllTypes(): Map<Type, Pair<Instant?, Long>> {
   294→        val response =
   295→            esClient.search(
   296→                { s ->
   297→                    s
   298→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   299→                        .size(0) // We only need aggregation results
   300→                        .aggregations("by_type") { agg ->
   301→                            agg
   302→                                .terms { t ->
   303→                                    t.field("type").size(Type.entries.size)
   304→                                }.aggregations("max_updated_time") { subAgg ->
   305→                                    subAgg.max { m -> m.field("updatedTime") }
   306→                                }
   307→                        }
   308→                },
   309→                Dictionary::class.java,
   310→            )
   311→
   312→        val byTypeAgg = response.aggregations()["by_type"]?.sterms()
   313→        val resultMap = mutableMapOf<Type, Pair<Instant?, Long>>()
   314→
   315→        // Initialize all types with null/0
   316→        Type.entries.forEach { type ->
   317→            resultMap[type] = Pair(null, 0L)
   318→        }
   319→
   320→        // Update with actual values from aggregation
   321→        byTypeAgg?.buckets()?.array()?.forEach { bucket ->
   322→            val typeName = bucket.key().stringValue()
   323→            val type = Type.entries.find { it.name == typeName }
   324→            if (type != null) {
   325→                val count = bucket.docCount()
   326→                val maxAgg = bucket.aggregations()["max_updated_time"]?.max()
   327→                val lastModified =
   328→                    maxAgg?.value()?.takeIf { !it.isNaN() }?.let {
   329→                        Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.toLong())
   330→                    }
   331→                resultMap[type] = Pair(lastModified, count)
   332→            }
   333→        }
   334→
   335→        return resultMap
   336→    }
   337→
   338→    override fun countAllTypes(): Map<Type, Long> {
   339→        val response =
   340→            esClient.search(
   341→                { s ->
   342→                    s
   343→                        .index(DICTIONARY_INDEX)
   344→                        .size(0) // We only need aggregation results
   345→                        .aggregations("by_type") { agg ->
   346→                            agg.terms { t ->
   347→                                t.field("type").size(Type.entries.size)
   348→                            }
   349→                        }
   350→                },
   351→                Dictionary::class.java,
   352→            )
   353→
   354→        val byTypeAgg = response.aggregations()["by_type"]?.sterms()
   355→        val resultMap = mutableMapOf<Type, Long>()
   356→
   357→        // Initialize all types with 0
   358→        Type.entries.forEach { type ->
   359→            resultMap[type] = 0L
   360→        }
   361→
   362→        // Update with actual values from aggregation
   363→        byTypeAgg?.buckets()?.array()?.forEach { bucket ->
   364→            val typeName = bucket.key().stringValue()
   365→            val type = Type.entries.find { it.name == typeName }
   366→            if (type != null) {
   367→                resultMap[type] = bucket.docCount()
   368→            }
   369→        }
   370→
   371→        return resultMap
   372→    }

   374→    private fun baseSortQuery() =
   375→        SortOptions.of {
   376→            it.field { f ->
   377→                f.field("updatedTime")
   378→                f.order(SortOrder.Desc)
   379→            }
   380→            it.field { f2 ->
   381→                f2.field("createdTime")
   382→                f2.order(SortOrder.Desc)
   383→            }
   384→        }
   385→
   386→    private fun searchAfterSortQuery(): List<SortOptions> =
   387→        listOf(
   388→            SortOptions.of { it.field { f -> f.field("updatedTime").order(SortOrder.Desc) } },
   389→            SortOptions.of { it.field { f -> f.field("createdTime").order(SortOrder.Desc) } },
   390→            // Use _shard_doc instead of _id (ES 8.x disallows _id fielddata by default)
   391→            SortOptions.of { it.field { f -> f.field("_shard_doc").order(SortOrder.Asc) } },
   392→        )

   395→        const val DICTIONARY_INDEX = ".dsearch_dict"
   396→    }
